ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-muzzammil(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: O THOU enwrapped one!

ayahs.textArabic: قُمِ الَّيْلَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qumil-laila illā qalīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Keep awake [in prayer] at night, all but a small part

ayahs.textArabic: نِّصْفَهٗٓ اَوِ انْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيْلًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Niṣfahū awinquṣ minhu qalīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: of one-half thereof - or make it a little less than that,

ayahs.textArabic: اَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَرْتِيْلًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Au zid ‘alaihi wa rattilil-qur'āna tartīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: or add to it [at will]; and [during that time] recite the Qur’an calmly and distinctly, with thy mind attuned to its meaning.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا سَنُلْقِيْ عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innā sanulqī ‘alaika qaulan ṡaqīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, We shall bestow upon thee a weighty message –

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ الَّيْلِ هِيَ اَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَّاَقْوَمُ قِيْلًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna nāsyi'atal-laili hiya asyaddu waṭ'aw wa aqwamu qīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and,] verily, the hours of night the mind most strongly and speak with the clearest voice,

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ لَكَ فِى النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيْلًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna laka fin-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas by day a long chain of doings is thy portion.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ اِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيْلًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkurisma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabtīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [whether by night or by day,] remember thy Sustainer's name, and devote thyself unto Him with utter devotion.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbul-masyriqi wal-magribi lā ilāha illā huwa fattakhiżhu wakīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: The Sustainer of the east and the west [is He]: there is no deity save Him: hence, ascribe to Him alone the power to determine thy fate,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Waṣbir ‘alā mā yaqūlūna wahjurhum hajran jamīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and endure with patience whatever people may say [against thee], and avoid them with a comely avoidance.

ayahs.textArabic: وَذَرْنِيْ وَالْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ اُولِى النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa żarnī wal-mukażżibīna ulin-na‘mati wa mahhilhum qalīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And leave Me alone [to deal] with those who give the lie to the truth - those who enjoy the blessings of life [without any thought of God] - and bear thou with them for a little while:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ اَنْكَالًا وَّجَحِيْمًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna ladainā ankālaw wa jaḥīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, behold, heavy fetters [await them] with Us, and a blazing fire,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَّعَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ṭa‘āman żā guṣṣatiw wa ‘ażāban alīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and food that chokes, and grievous suffering

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْاَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيْبًا مَّهِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma tarjuful-arḍu wal-jibālu wa kānatil-jibālu kaṡībam mahīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will be convulsed and the mountains will [crumble and] become like a sand-dune on the move!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْكُمْ رَسُوْلًا ەۙ شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُوْلًا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā arsalnā ilaikum rasūlā(n), syāhidan ‘alaikum kamā arsalnā ilā fir‘auna rasūlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, [O men,] We have sent unto you an apostle who shall bear witness to the truth before you, even as We sent an apostle unto Pharaoh:

ayahs.textArabic: فَعَصٰى فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُوْلَ فَاَخَذْنٰهُ اَخْذًا وَّبِيْلًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ‘aṣā fir‘aunar-rasūla fa akhażnāhu akhżaw wabīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and Pharaoh rebelled against the apostle, whereupon We took him to task with a crushing grip.

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُوْنَ اِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَّجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيْبًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fakaifa tattaqūna in kafartum yaumay yaj‘alul-wildāna syībā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: How, then, if you refuse to acknowledge the truth, will you protect yourselves on that Day which shall turn the hair of children grey,

ayahs.textArabic: ۨالسَّمَاۤءُ مُنْفَطِرٌۢ بِهٖۗ كَانَ وَعْدُهٗ مَفْعُوْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: As-samā'u munfaṭirum bih(ī), kāna wa‘duhū maf‘ūlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [the Day] on which the skies shall be rent asunder, [and] His promise [of resurrection] fulfilled?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۚ فَمَنْ شَاۤءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِيْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hāżihī tażkirah(tun), faman syā'attakhaża ilā rabbihī sabīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: This, verily, is a reminder: let him who wills, then set out on a way to his Sustainer!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ تَقُوْمُ اَدْنٰى مِنْ ثُلُثَيِ الَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهٗ وَثُلُثَهٗ وَطَاۤىِٕفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ مَعَكَۗ وَاللّٰهُ يُقَدِّرُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَۗ عَلِمَ اَنْ لَّنْ تُحْصُوْهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْرَءُوْا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِۗ عَلِمَ اَنْ سَيَكُوْنُ مِنْكُمْ مَّرْضٰىۙ وَاٰخَرُوْنَ يَضْرِبُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ يَبْتَغُوْنَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللّٰهِ ۙوَاٰخَرُوْنَ يُقَاتِلُوْنَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۖفَاقْرَءُوْا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُۙ وَاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَقْرِضُوا اللّٰهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًاۗ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوْا لِاَنْفُسِكُمْ مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوْهُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ۙهُوَ خَيْرًا وَّاَعْظَمَ اَجْرًاۗ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللّٰهَ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna rabbaka ya‘lamu annaka taqūmu adnā min ṡuluṡayil-laili wa niṣfahū wa ṡuluṡahū wa ṭā'ifatum minal-lażīna ma‘ak(a), wallāhu yuqaddirul-laila wan-nahār(a), ‘alima allan tuḥṣūhu fa tāba ‘alaikum faqra'ū mā tayassara minal-qur'ān(i), ‘alima an sayakūnu minkum marḍā, wa ākharūna yaḍribūna fil-arḍi yabtagūna min faḍlillāh(i), wa ākharūna yuqātilūna fī sabīlillāh(i), faqra'ū mā tayassara minh(u), wa aqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wa ātuz-zakāta wa aqriḍullāha qarḍan ḥasanā(n), wa mā tuqaddimū li'anfusikum min khairin tajidūhu ‘indallāh(i), huwa khairaw wa a‘ẓama ajrā(n), wastagfirullāh(a), innallāha gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, [O Prophet,] thy Sustainer knows that thou keepest awake [in prayer] nearly two-thirds of the night, or one-half of it, or a third of it, together with some of those who follow thee. And God who determines the measure of night and day, is aware that you would never grudge it: and therefore He turns towards you in His grace. Recite, then, as much of the Qur’an as you may do with ease. He knows that in time there will be among you sick people, and others who will go about the land in search of God's bounty, and others who will fight in God’s cause. Recite, then, [only] as much of it as you may do with ease, and be constant in prayer, and spend in charity, and [thus] lend unto God a goodly loan: for whatever good deed you may offer up in your own behalf, you shall truly find it with God - yea, better, and richer in reward. And [always] seek God's forgiveness: behold, God is much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace!
